rationale: Dev is building low-code AI orchestration tooling at Gooey.AI and actively thinking about intelligent model orchestration, while Watson evaluates AI agent performance and reliability at TikTok—putting them at complementary points in the LLM-tooling stack. They could explore how evaluation frameworks inform orchestration design, and whether TikTok's consumer-AI context creates opportunities for Dev's multilingual and small-model approaches.
intro_message: Dev Aggarwal, meet Watson — you're both deep in AI infrastructure (orchestration vs. agent evaluation) and could compare notes on how evals shape real-world deployment decisions.
